channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French grammar tips: How to decipher dessous, dessus and dehors
item.description: Although these three French words may look similar, they do not mean the same thing.

item.title: France updates website that helps you calculate your French pension
item.description: France's useful online simulator which helps workers accurately plan for their retirement has been updated to take into account the suspension of the flagship pension reform.

item.title: OPINION: Dear Americans moving to France, yes, you'll be safe here
item.description: The number of Americans moving to France is on the rise and thousands more are thinking of making the move. The one question many are asking is.. 'is France safe?'. Writer Samantha David tries to clear a few things up.

item.title: France's Macron says Epstein affair 'mainly concerns' US
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron Monday distanced France from the Jeffrey Epstein scandal, saying it "mainly concerns" the United States after ex-minister Jack Lang resigned from a top cultural post over links to the late sex offender.

item.title: 'Parisians are breathing better': New plans unveiled to transform Paris
item.description: Emmanuel Grégoire, considered a frontrunner in the race for mayor of Paris, has set out his plan for pedestrian boulevards, increased green spaces, and reduced car traffic in the city.

item.title: Drivers in south-west France face tougher penalties if caught using phone
item.description: Drivers in parts of south-western France now risk losing their licence if they are caught using their mobile phone whilst at the wheel.

item.title: French expression of the day: de fil en aiguille
item.description: Based on a sewing practice, this French expression is used differently today.

item.title: 'It has to be done': Macron backs ripping up vines as French wine sales dive
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron insisted Monday that ripping up unprofitable grape vines was a necessary part of revitalising the flagging wine sector which he promised to defend.

item.title: Why you have to go to the French Riviera's famous Lemon Festival
item.description: The Fête du Citron in Menton, on the French Riviera is set to attract 200,000 visitors to the sun-soaked town and you should be among them.

item.title: 'Much improved': The verdict on how good the internet is in rural France
item.description: The rollout of high-speed fibre internet across France enters a new phase this year. We asked the readers of The Local living in rural France to rate their internet speed and see if they had noticed any improvement in recent months and years.
